notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register, firelookout.com and the FFLA list agree on a 1941 cabin, now gone. No source read gives staffing, fires, access or current condition, so facts.access and facts.staffing are omitted and the story says nothing about them. The record's panorama file name (brumback-loh-8-19-35.jpg) may point to an August 1935 date, which would predate the 1941 build year. That is a guess from a file name, not a source statement, so it is left out of the story; an editor may want to check the National Archives original. Kemnow's Brumback page gives only the ODF legal line (1N-47E-19) and adds nothing else. Used 2 WebSearch and about 6 page reads.
